subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, “How wonderful the view is!”

options.text: She said how wonderful the view is.
She exclaimed that the view was very wonderful.
She said that the view is wonderful.
She exclaimed that the view was wonderful.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

• **Indirect Speech:** She exclaimed that the view was wonderful.
